title: UFO-looking ancient cave art in Australia

tellings.quote: Australia, a lot of freaky cave art. A lot of freaky UFO looking art. Like weird stuff that thousands of years old.

plain: Australia is said to have a lot of "freaky" cave art thousands of years old, including images that look like UFOs. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan says this to Michels in passing, as something he has come across. If the images show what they seem to, people would have been seeing such things in the sky long before modern times.
